name: xuanxue-kernel
description: 纯前端术数排盘引擎：15 个体系、零依赖 ES Module。排盘由确定性算法算，AI 只解读不参与起局。

scripts.serve: node -e "import('node:http').then(async h=>{const fs=await import('node:fs/promises'),p=await import('node:path');h.createServer(async(q,r)=>{let f=p.join(process.cwd(),decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));if(f.endsWith('/'))f+='index.html';try{const b=await fs.readFile(f);const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg'};r.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':t[p.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});r.end(b)}catch{r.writeHead(404);r.end('404')}}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('http://localhost:8080'))})"

author: Honglouqaz
